voice: Optimistic, relatable, educational. Friendly, natural, easy to understand. Active verbs, simple words, plain examples. A little light humor is fine, never corny, exaggerated or salesy. No hyperbole or superlatives. No jargon unless defined.
tagline_rule: Use a tagline only as an occasional sign-off. Do not overuse.
approved_facts: Boost Oxygen provides supplemental oxygen, available anytime, anywhere.
95% pure oxygen (tested consistently by Atlantic Analytical Laboratory, results posted on boostoxygen.com).
Nearly 5X more oxygen than normal air.
Available in 18,000+ retailers across the USA.
